title: P4-13: secret-safe on-demand revalidation for Pretext sites
description: Pretext pages use revalidate = 3600. Immediate refresh on publish needs a shared secret between the backend (content-actions calls /api/revalidate) and the Next app, and the template has no secret-safe way to set it: a public site.json cannot hold it, and console-set branch variables are wiped by the next stack update (TI today keeps PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET as a plain branch env var). Design and implement a secret-safe path (e.g. Amplify backend secret read at runtime by both sides, or another mechanism that survives stack updates and never lands in site.json or Git), update app/api/revalidate/route.ts, the content-actions trigger, the template and docs, with tests. Rotate the existing TI secret at cutover; the new backend must not reuse it. Sequence after P5-01 (PPY-f1f695), which also touches app/api/revalidate/route.ts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged PR #153 (squash 9d69d89). Design: shared secret is an SSM SecureString /papyrus/<siteId>/revalidate-secret, created once by a human; the template sets only the parameter name (PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET_PARAMETER) on main and grants the SSR compute role ssm:GetParameter on that one parameter; site-backend.ts grants content-actions the same read. Route and trigger read it at runtime (route caches 5 min, fails closed, constant-time compare). Removed: PAPYRUS_REVALIDATE_SECRET env var, readerCache.revalidateSecret, backend secret(). One-time step in docs/site-hosting.md. Tests: test:revalidate-secret, test:infra-synth, Python reader revalidation. CI green. Left open: the TI cutover must create the new parameter with a fresh value (not the old env var value) and delete the old branch variable.

right_now_summary: The TI cutover still needs a fresh SSM secret and removal of the old branch variable.
